tools.name: publish_demand
tools.description: Submit B2B demand for review. MARS remains intermediary only.

tools.name: publish_offer
tools.description: Submit supplier offer/capability for review.

tools.name: find_counterparty
tools.description: Search reviewed public demand or offers.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Create a quarantined RFQ without automatic contact.

tools.name: submit_commission_mandate
tools.description: Verify and record a principal-signed ECDSA P-256 commission mandate.

tools.name: record_attribution
tools.description: Record a Buyer-Supplier introduction under an active verified mandate.

tools.name: record_commission_event
tools.description: Verify principal-signed contract/payment evidence and update the commission evidence ledger without moving money.

tools.name: discover_commercial_counterparties
tools.description: Discover commercial public A2A/MCP services and B2B SaaS commission programs. Never contacts them automatically.

tools.name: discover_buyer_demand
tools.description: Discover live open Buyer demand from official procurement sources. No automatic contact and no money movement.

tools.name: qualify_buyer_demand
tools.description: Commercially qualify live Buyer demand: official structured terms, deadline, supplier requirements, direct entry route, and MARS intermediary commission-route policy. Never contacts buyers or moves money.

tools.name: match_verified_suppliers
tools.description: Match qualified live Buyer demand to suppliers using exact CPV or strong visible semantic official-award evidence, report eligibility gaps, and preserve a signed-mandate gate. Never contacts parties or moves money.

tools.name: build_economic_opportunity_portfolio
tools.description: Build a ranked portfolio across multiple buyer-demand families with deduplicated buyers, capability-verified suppliers, sequential external-source execution, targeted supplier recovery and no named-counterparty deployment gate.

tools.name: build_portfolio_conversion_queue
tools.description: Build a portfolio-wide public business-contact enrichment and formal-eligibility outreach queue. Requests are deduplicated, deadline-prioritized, owner-approval gated, and never sent automatically.

tools.name: prepare_supplier_eligibility_request
tools.description: Prepare but do not send a supplier eligibility evidence request for capability-verified suppliers with public contact routes. Does not mark eligibility or commission agreement verified.

tools.name: verify_supplier_public_evidence
tools.description: Read public supplier websites for contact and supporting capability evidence, then prepare a narrower formal eligibility request without sending it or treating self-published material as formal procurement eligibility proof.

tools.name: intake_supplier_formal_eligibility
tools.description: Map supplier-provided formal document evidence to procurement requirements. Public intake never self-approves authenticity or eligibility and never sends contact.

tools.name: prepare_formal_eligibility_outreach
tools.description: Prepare the exact supplier-facing eligibility evidence request, correlation id, deadline and response schema. It never sends contact automatically.

tools.name: intake_formal_eligibility_response
tools.description: Correlate a supplier response with a prepared request and map evidence into fail-closed formal review. Receipt does not verify sender identity, authenticity or eligibility.

tools.name: prepare_commission_mandate_draft
tools.description: Prepare a fail-closed commission mandate draft view. Public calls cannot bypass authorized eligibility review and cannot sign, send or activate a mandate.

tools.name: submit_partner_application
tools.description: Submit a supplier/referral partnership application for identity and terms review.

tools.name: prepare_onboarding_proposal
tools.description: Prepare but do not send a partner onboarding proposal.

tools.name: mars_free_commercial_intelligence_preview
tools.description: FREE: return one evidence-bearing public supplier/procurement discovery result. The response includes the exact continuation to the 0.05 USDC Base Mainnet x402 service. No payment is required for this tool.

tools.name: mars_x402_commercial_intelligence_offer
tools.description: Inspect the exact paid-service offer without paying. Returns the HTTP x402 endpoint, 0.05 USDC price, Base Mainnet network, asset and receiver. To buy, call the returned HTTP endpoint and satisfy its standard x402 Payment-Required challenge.

tools.name: mars_micro_commercial_intelligence_offer
tools.description: One-call paid procurement evidence for supplier sourcing, vendor discovery, verified industrial suppliers and procurement counterparty research. No MARS account or subscription is required. First tools/call returns x402 v2 PaymentRequired for exactly 0.005 USDC on Base Mainnet; retry the SAME tools/

tools.name: mars_deal_route_precheck
tools.description: FREE first-stop routing precheck. Send a deal to MARS first; MARS evaluates preliminary fit, economics evidence, and whether it should handle/orchestrate the deal or route it to an external agent/provider. This tool does not accept jobs, contact counterparties, execute providers, broadcast transacti

tools.name: mars_purchase_feedback
tools.description: FREE optional reason-coded feedback. No free text, IP, User-Agent, referrer, or raw journey id is stored.

tools.name: mars_commerce_quote
tools.description: FREE task-to-price resolver. Describe the commercial task; MARS returns the selected value contract, exact price, alternatives, and the one paid execution URL. No payment is performed by this tool.

tools.name: mars_commerce_reputation
tools.description: FREE evidence-only reliability view. Separates external settlement evidence from controlled or unattributed settlement evidence and exposes non-test usage counts without synthetic scores.

tools.name: mars_commerce_recover
tools.description: FREE recovery after TOO_EXPENSIVE, PAYMENT_UNSUPPORTED, INSUFFICIENT_TRUST or another structured feedback reason. Uses buyer budget when provided and never performs payment.

tools.name: mars_commerce_handshake
tools.description: FREE read-only capability and commercial compatibility handshake. Returns canonical Commerce V3, x402 rail, tiers and policy invariants. This tool never performs payment or contact.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_commission_mandate_draft · Private data: request_quote, submit_commission_mandate, record_attribution, record_commission_event, discover_commercial_counterparties, discover_buyer_demand, qualify_buyer_demand, match_verified_suppliers, build_portfolio_conversion_queue, prepare_supplier_eligibility_request, verify_supplier_public_evidence, intake_supplier_formal_eligibility, prepare_formal_eligibility_outreach, mars_deal_route_precheck, mars_commerce_handshake · Public sink: publish_demand, publish_offer, submit_commission_mandate, prepare_supplier_eligibility_request, prepare_commission_mandate_draft, submit_partner_application, prepare_onboarding_proposal, mars_deal_route_precheck · Destructive: mars_deal_route_precheck.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_commission_mandate_draft · Private data: request_quote, submit_commission_mandate, record_attribution, record_commission_event, discover_commercial_counterparties, discover_buyer_demand, qualify_buyer_demand, match_verified_suppliers, build_portfolio_conversion_queue, prepare_supplier_eligibility_request, verify_supplier_public_evidence, intake_supplier_formal_eligibility, prepare_formal_eligibility_outreach, mars_deal_route_precheck, mars_commerce_handshake · Public sink: publish_demand, publish_offer, submit_commission_mandate, prepare_supplier_eligibility_request, prepare_commission_mandate_draft, submit_partner_application, prepare_onboarding_proposal, mars_deal_route_precheck · Destructive: mars_deal_route_precheck

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "mars_micro_commercial_intelligence_offer" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Inspect the 0.01 USDC Base Mainnet x402 proof offer. It returns 3 evidence-ranked results plus a compact decision summary before you commit to the 0.05 USDC full product." → after: "One-call paid procurement evidence for supplier sourcing, vendor discovery, verified industrial suppliers and procurement counterparty research. No MARS account or subscription is required. First tools/call returns x402 v2 PaymentRequired for exactly 0.005 USDC on Base Mainnet; retry the SAME tools/"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
